textContent: I am delighted to curate this bespoke itinerary for you! Based on your preferences, I have crafted a 9-day luxury journey across Cairo & Luxor & Aswan. Review the day-by-day plan below!

days.title: Arrival in Cairo & VIP Welcome
days.description: Arrival at Cairo International Airport, executive meet-and-assist by Dunas Travel concierge, and private transfer to 5-star hotel.

days.title: Giza Pyramids, Saqqara & Grand Egyptian Museum
days.description: Private Egyptologist-led expedition to the Great Pyramids of Giza, Sphinx, Djoser Step Pyramid in Saqqara, and Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM).

days.title: Flight to Aswan & Nile Cruise Embarkation
days.description: Domestic flight to Aswan, embarkation on luxury Nile Cruise / private Dahabiya, visit to Philae Temple, High Dam, and sunset felucca ride.

days.title: Kom Ombo & Edfu Temples Navigation
days.description: Sail north to the dual Temple of Kom Ombo and Crocodile Museum, followed by chariot excursion to Horus Temple in Edfu.

days.title: Luxor: Valley of the Kings & Karnak Temples
days.description: Arrival in Luxor, private exploration of Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, and grand Karnak & Luxor Temples illuminated by night.

days.title: Cairo Return & International Departure
days.description: Breakfast, private transfer to Cairo International Airport, VIP exit assistance, and international flight departure.

proposal.title: Custom 9-Day Itinerary: Cairo + Luxor + Aswan
highlights: Private Mercedes fleet transfers & VIP airport concierge
inclusions: All domestic flights & private ground transfers
